text: Worst dentist ever been to. Felt like I was going to a fast food shop, the cleaning was done in 15 min and was the most painful cleaning ever had.

restaurant_name: Prawet Dental Clinic คลินิกทันตกรรมประเวศ
text:
The staff, doctors, and other clinic staff are very polite.
The service is excellent. I was initially hesitant to go because of the previous reviews.
However, since it's close to my house and I called ahead, they called me when the doctor arrived. The price is reasonable. I took my housekeeper to get a tooth extracted for 500 baht. It was excellent.
